exposure: Planned induction of vaginal breech delivery limited to one day
cohort: The study included 72 women with singleton breech pregnancies at 37-38 weeks' gestation who underwent a planned induction of vaginal breech delivery between April 2006 and March 2016.
finding: Planned vaginal breech delivery limited to one day at 37-38 weeks' gestation appeared valid and safe, representing a potential option for breech delivery in Japan.
mod_finding: The completion rate of vaginal delivery was 67%, with cesarean delivery selected if vaginal delivery was not expected by evening.
